title: SystemMap
description: `system-map.yml`. Node and seam ids are the only identifiers pins and plans may use.

owner_rule.description: Prose rule for who owns a seam. Informational.

repos.description: Repositories behind the nodes, with per-repo overrides (ADR 0009).

scenarios.description:
Named journeys through the system, as ordered steps over declared flows (ADR 0024).
Optional; a map without scenarios is still version 1.

Flow.description:
One thing crossing a seam in one direction. `from` and `to` are the seam's two nodes, in
either order.

carries.description: What it carries: a type, a message, a command.

FlowKind.description: Data moves; control tells the other side to do something.

repo.description: `owner/name` of the repository holding the code, if any.

oneOf.description: A format or schema others agree on.

RepoRef.description: A repository behind one or more nodes.

plan_path.description: Plan path template with `{issue}` and `{slug}` placeholders. Default `docs/plans/{issue}.md`.

Scenario.description:
A named journey: what crosses which seam, in order, when someone uses the system (ADR 0024).
Its id shares the namespace of node and seam ids but is not one a pin or plan may name.

name.description: Short title shown in the scenario picker.

steps.description: In order. Steps need not be contiguous: a journey may jump to another part.

ScenarioStep.description:
One step: a flow declared on `seam`, picked by its kind and direction, and by `carries` when
the seam declares more than one flow with that kind and direction.

carries.description: Must equal the flow's `carries`; required only to tell two such flows apart.

says.description: What happens at this step, in words, for the caption.

Seam.description: A seam between two nodes. The owner side is woken when it breaks.

description.description: What this seam is for, in a sentence a newcomer can read.

flows.description:
What crosses this seam, one entry per thing and direction (ADR 0017). Optional: a seam
without flows is drawn as a plain dependency from `from` to `to`.

guard.description: The check that guards this seam.

owner.description: Node id of the owner side; must be `from` or `to`.
